dedupe_keys.name: temps de correspondance minimaux entre operateurs sncf voyageurs

description: Temps de correspondance minimaux entre opérateurs SNCF Voyageurs is a dataset listed in SNCF Open Data, an open data portal of a railway operator, published or maintained by SNCF. Suite à l’application du règlement sur les « Droits et Obligations des Voyageurs ferroviaires (DOV) » ou « Passenger Rights Regulation (PRR) » par SNCF Voyageurs, ce jeu de données permet de reconstituer les temps de correspondance minimaux fixés par SNCF Voyageurs pour répondre à l’un des critères d’éligibilité au billet direct. Coverage: France. The portal files it under Horaires et itinéraires. Its keywords are correspondance, billet direct, PRR. The portal shows 2023-06-13 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Database License (ODbL) (https://data.sncf.com/pages/cgu/A1#A1). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-sncf-open-data-portal.
